title: Takeaways From Charles Spencer’s Memoir, “Swan Song,” About Princess Diana
summary: Nearly 30 years after Princess Diana died, her brother has written a book about her life, her marriage to Prince Charles and the suffering she endured at the hands of the tabloid press.
